matched_books.title: The Secret Billionaire's Unexpected Bride
matched_books.synopsis: Scarlett, a kind‑hearted and resilient delivery rider, enters a flash marriage with Ethan, the CEO of Imperial Group who is disguised as a poor young man, in order to hold onto her late mother’s keepsakes. As they live together after marriage, feelings gradually blossom between them. Behind the scenes, Ethan helps her resolve workplace crises. When his true identity as a corporate president comes to light, his former fiancée teams up with their bitter rival to set her up. Amid life‑threatening danger, Scarlett recognizes her true feelings, and the two finally rebuild their trust hand‑in‑hand.

matched_books.title: Fake Angel's Final Fall
matched_books.synopsis: Billion-dollar conglomerate founder Sarah returns home, keeping her wealth hidden, hoping only for a quiet wedding. Unexpectedly, Hailey, her son's fiancée, humiliates her relentlessly to seize her wedding venue — completely unaware that the victim before her is none other than her fiancé's own mother! Hailey resorts to extreme violence. She shoots Sarah and has her bound and drowned in a resort pool to silence her. Miraculously surviving, Sarah refuses her son's protection. Disguised as a waitress, she infiltrates the engagement gala. Before the city's elite and assembled media, witnesses and irrefutable evidence come to light, exposing Hailey’s full conspiracy: fake-pregnancy fraud, embezzlement, and attempted murder. The villain is publicly ruined. Sarah makes her triumphant return, reclaiming everything that belongs to her!
